offer.description:
As Head of Product, your mission is to lead the product organization that builds what our users bank with every day, ensuring they get the safe, smart and effortless banking they expect.

Why this matters:
At bunq, our mission is to Make Life Easy, for our users, our teams, and the world around us.

Every team plays a unique role in making this mission a reality. The Product team does this by building and improving the products our users bank with, while keeping them safe and compliant.

As Head of Product, you contribute by setting product direction and leading the product leaders who deliver it, helping us grow as the bank of The Free.

Take ownership:
As Head of Product, you’ll take charge of key responsibilities that directly impact bunq’s growth and our users’ seamless experience:

  • Grow our users’ use of bunq’s products by leading product strategy and delivery for your area.

  • Keep growth and safety moving together, so that fraud, compliance and quality are built into the products rather than bolted on.

  • Build a strong, AI-first product organization by leading Product Owners and Team Leads, and redesigning how the function works around AI agents instead of adding headcount by default.

  • Be bunq’s product voice with the management board, regulators, auditors and partners.

💡 Each country has different rules for eligibility to work without requiring sponsorship.


🇳🇱 Netherlands: You must be a Dutch/EU/EEA/Swiss citizen, or hold a valid Dutch residence permit with full work rights (e.g., refugee status, spousal visa, or permanent residence).

🇧🇬 Bulgaria: You must have the legal right to work in Bulgaria without needing a company-sponsored visa.

🇹🇷 Turkey: You must be a Turkish citizen, hold a Turquoise Card, refugee status, or a permanent residency/work permit (student/family/temporary residencies are not eligible to work without company sponsorship).


For this role, we are able to sponsor visas in a few other situations, so feel free to apply. 🌈

💡 If successful in the hiring process, the contractual arrangement would look like this: 

🇳🇱 Netherlands: A first contract of 9 months, extended with a second contract of 12 months, followed by an indefinite contract. 
🇹🇷 Turkey: A first contract of 9 months, extended with a second contract of 12 months, followed by an indefinite contract. 
🇧🇬 Bulgaria: an indefinite contract. 

💡 For the first 3 months, all new hires are required to be in the office 5 days a week to complete the onboarding process, get to know everyone, and immerse themselves in the culture of bunq. After that, the work arrangement will be hybrid, with 3 days in the office and 2 days working from home.


💡 Our standard working hours are from 09:00 to 18:00. This ensures that everyone is available and can rely on each other during this time.
